title: Winning Moves
dedication: Made for Garrett, who is going to be better at this than the person who built it.

parts.title: The rules of the game
parts.blurb: What a game is, how to write one down as a grid of numbers, and the two ideas everything else is built on: best responses and equilibrium.

parts.title: Games with turns
parts.blurb: Games you can solve completely by thinking backwards from the end. Secrets hidden in remainders, in binary, and in proofs that tell you a winner exists without telling you how to win.

parts.title: Playing with people
parts.blurb: When the other player is a person: repeating a game changes everything, sharing fairly is harder than it looks, and auctions and elections are games too.

parts.title: Chance, crowds, and clever puzzles
parts.blurb: Games against chance, games with thousands of players, and puzzles where the whole trick is figuring out what everybody else knows.
